findings.title: Concurrent copies of one signed companion frame both pass nonce replay checks
findings.trigger: Two authentic envelopes with the same nonce enter verification before asynchronous hashing returns.
findings.observed: Sequential duplicate rejected and invalid MAC rejected; concurrent authentic duplicate accepted twice; nonce cache then has one entry.
findings.cause: Nonce presence is tested before awaiting the digest and recorded afterward without a second check.
findings.impact: Duplicate authenticated inbound control frames can be applied, including repeated UI updates and notifications. This is not a signature forgery or demonstrated arbitrary command execution.
findings.suggested_change: After a valid digest, atomically recheck and record the nonce before returning acceptance. Do not let an invalid MAC reserve a nonce.

findings.title: A previously received companion frame mutates state after disconnect
findings.trigger: Disconnect while an old paired frame is awaiting HMAC verification.
findings.observed: Actual disconnect clears agents; releasing the pending digest restores old-pair-agent while status remains disconnected.
findings.cause: Incoming verification does not capture and revalidate the attempt/HMAC session after its await. The signaling callback only checks the attempt before verification.
findings.impact: Old paired task data can reappear after unpairing. Account-switch leakage and a native notification delivery were not demonstrated.
findings.suggested_change: Capture the incoming connection generation and HMAC identity, then check both after verification and before applying payloads. Apply the same ownership check to queued controls.

reachability.flags: FEATURES.companion and FEATURES.dispatch are true in the current v1FeatureFlags.ts; isDispatchCompanionEnabled reads those flags.
reachability.mount: Expo route companion/index.tsx connects scanned/deep-linked pairing codes, mounts notifications and exposes disconnect; app/_layout.tsx routes valid pairing links to it.

validation.instrument: Full unchanged TypeScript HMAC/connection/validator/flag/contract modules transpiled in memory; Node SHA256/randomness substitutes Expo crypto, with a digest gate to expose the asynchronous boundary. Real Zustand state; native transport, MMKV and unrelated stores are inert fixtures. Only private access appended in memory.
limits: No mounted native app or real pairing/signaling service run.
Source logic and asynchronous ownership failure reproduced; native transport timing and UI/notification effects remain unverified.
